Port QoS for action:/navigate_to_pose records the goal-service default of the action client; the code passes no QoS options. Separately, the panel subscribes on the RViz display node to navigate_to_pose/_action/feedback and navigate_to_pose/_action/status with rclcpp::SystemDefaultsQoS() (nav2_panel.cpp:390-415); the reliability/durability of those are chosen by the RMW implementation, not statically. frame is per_message: the PoseStamped header.frame_id is set per goal from the RViz fixed frame (context_->getFixedFrame(), goal_tool.cpp:48, passed through the GoalPoseUpdater Qt signal to Nav2Panel::onNewGoal); no frame string is hard-coded. header.stamp = rclcpp::Clock().now() (nav2_panel.cpp:511): a default-constructed rclcpp::Clock is RCL_SYSTEM_TIME, not the node's ROS clock.
